name: PNB 2274
title: Enhanced Human Physiology and Anatomy
description: Fundamentals of human physiology and anatomy enhanced through inquiry-based laboratories.
requirement_description: BIOL 1107; CHEM 1124Q or 1127Q. Not open for credit to students who have passed PNB 2264. May not be taken out of sequence after passing PNB 2275, 3264, or 4162. Repeat restrictions apply; see advising.uconn.edu/repeat-policy for details.
